checks: Authenticated production endpoint performs real offline semantic search
API validates query and top-k bounds
Existing 12 HTTP authentication/SQL/MongoDB checks pass on the revised build
Missing offline model returns 503 without keyword fallback
Dashboard and incident creation work while embedding model is unavailable

example.sql:
SELECT emergency_id,description,status,severity_level,
  embedding <=> $1::vector AS cosine_distance,
  1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS cosine_similarity
FROM emergencies
WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL AND embedding_model=$2
ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector
LIMIT $3

note: The sixth item summarizes the existing 12 HTTP checks and is not counted twice.
